senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גֹּלֶם, גלם)a rolled up, shapeless mass, whence

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> and the other limbs of the embryo look <he>כמין ג׳ מצומתים</he> like a lump, squeezed together.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>העמידו ג׳</he> He made him stand, a large, lifeless mass.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Ib.</cite> s. 24 <he>ג׳ בראו וכ׳</he> He formed him into a huge body, which extended from one end &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 139:16">Ps. CXXXIX, 16</cite>) <he>ג׳ שראו עיניך</he> (read <he>גּוֹלָמִים</he>) the embryos which Thy eyes have seen, have all been recorded (preordained) &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> <he>גלומי היו</he> (read <he>גְּלוּמִין</he> or <he>גולמין</he>) they were (hard) lumps (blocks).

senses.gloss: unfinished matter, a vessel wanting finishing, opp. פשוט plain surface, forming no receptacle.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22b:3">Snh. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה ג׳ היא ואינה וכ׳</he> woman (unmarried) is an unfinished vessel, and she makes a covenant with (cares for) none but him who made her a vessel.—Pl. <he>גּוֹלָמִים</he>, <cite ref="C00927"><he>גֳּלָ׳</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="C00401"><he>גּוֹלְמֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:6">Kel. XII, 6</cite> <he>ג׳ כלי מתכות</he> unfinished metal vessels, v. defin.
<cite ref="Chullin 25a:12">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:12">Ib. VII, 12</cite> <he>גֹלָמִין</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>גלמי</he>) pumpkins in their natural shape, opp. to <he>חתוכין ומנוקבין</he>.—
Sifré Num. 158 כלים ולא גלומים (Yalk. ib. 786 גּוֹלְמִין) ‘vessels’ which means finished vessels but not half-finished.—Trnsf. uneducated, unrefined.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:5">Sifré Num. 131</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771:21">Yalk. ib. 771</cite> the spear entered <he>בשני ג׳</he> both bodies.
